temperature_policy: Aka's existing hardware thermal controls unchanged; no added 95 C software policy. Tdie if present else Tctl, with 100 C emergency ceiling for all raw CPU sensors. This does not certify compliance with AMD's 95 C listed operating temperature. Zao permits 100 C equality; Unzen aborts at CPU >=100 C. Abort at any available CPU critical alarm or SSD composite >=80 C.
